profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Mozilla | Tech Lead, Project Planning
profile.summary:
With over four years at Mozilla, I currently serve as a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead for Glean, Mozilla’s cross-platform telemetry SDK. My work emphasizes API design, metric lifecycle guarantees, and cross-platform consistency, all while upholding Mozilla’s principles of privacy, consent, and data minimization.  

My contributions focus on architectural leadership, mentoring, and fostering collaboration across teams to ensure scalable and reliable telemetry infrastructure. Dedicated to reducing systemic risks and improving data quality, I aim to empower teams and drive innovation in open-source software development.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead for Glean, Mozilla’s cross-platform telemetry SDK used across Firefox and other Mozilla products. Owned the technical direction and long-term health of the SDK, including API design, metric lifecycle guarantees, and cross-platform consistency across Rust and multiple client languages.

Provided architectural leadership while remaining hands-on, mentoring engineers and guiding design reviews across Application Services and client teams. Focused on reducing systemic risk, improving data quality, and ensuring telemetry infrastructure scaled responsibly while meeting Mozilla’s privacy, consent, and data minimization principles.

Key contributions:
	•	Set and enforced SDK standards for metrics APIs, schema evolution, and correctness guarantees
	•	Led cross-team technical alignment between telemetry, client integrations, and data consumers
	•	Mentored engineers and acted as a force multiplier across teams
	•	Contributed to multi-language support (including tooling like uniffi-rs) to strengthen cross-platform bindings
	•	Improved long-term maintainability and trustworthiness of Mozilla’s telemetry infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core contributor to Glean, Mozilla’s telemetry SDK, with deep ownership of metrics APIs, schema design, and SDK guarantees. Worked closely with product, data science, and client teams to enable reliable, privacy-preserving measurement at scale while improving developer ergonomics and adoption.

Embedded for nearly a year with the Nimbus experimentation team, where you applied cross-platform telemetry experience to help shape experimentation architecture. Contributed several architectural innovations that improved experiment measurability, client integration patterns, and data reliability across desktop and mobile platforms, acting as a technical bridge between telemetry and experimentation without formal project leadership.

Key contributions:
	•	Designed and implemented core Glean telemetry APIs used across Firefox desktop and mobile
	•	Improved metric lifecycle management and schema validation, reducing data quality issues
	•	Contributed to Nimbus experimentation architecture, improving observability and experiment trust
	•	Worked on supporting tooling such as glean_parser to improve correctness and automation
	•	Extended telemetry reach via contributions to glean.js and Firefox product integrations
	•	Collaborated closely with experimentation, data science, and client teams across Mozilla

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description:
• Developed and taught a new game design and development course at Crowder College, approved by the dean.  
• Focused on foundational principles and iterative design methodologies using C++ and Unity.  
• Engaged students through hands-on projects, fostering creativity and technical skills in game development.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · Open-Source Software · System Architecture · Communication · Software Engineering · Software Development

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: At Missouri Southern State University, I engaged students in iOS development, emphasizing the Swift programming language. My teaching approach focused on guiding learners from basic concepts to the creation of fully functional SpriteKit games, fostering their practical skills and critical thinking. I aimed to inspire innovation in their projects, preparing them for real-world challenges in app development.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · Open-Source Software · System Architecture · Communication · Software Engineering · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: At Industrial Control Systems, I contributed significantly to the development of data collection software that optimized factory floor operations. My focus on user interface design greatly improved the visibility of processes, while my expertise in ensuring interoperability with programmable logic controllers enhanced system integration. This role allowed me to deepen my knowledge in software design and user interface development within industrial control systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Microcontrollers · Project Planning · C (Programming Language) · System Architecture · Communication · Electronics · Software Engineering · Software Development · Embedded Systems

positions.title: Co-Founder and Technical Lead
positions.description: At Adevsco LLC, I played a pivotal role in co-founding a company focused on creating tailored software solutions. As the Technical Lead, I oversaw project development, collaborated with a skilled team of 6 employees including 3 engineers, a project manager, a business analyst, and a master technician. I met frequently with clients to review design specifications and deliverables met their expectations. Our clients included companies from a broad range of industries including: industrial electrical contractors, warehouse operations, home and building automation, industrial control system engineering, industrial tank fabrication, fireworks distribution, and railway equipment maintenance.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · Open-Source Software · System Architecture · Communication · Software Engineering · Software Development · Embedded Systems

positions.title: Software Development Leader
positions.description: At PILR TECH, I played a pivotal role in leading a team of developers, ensuring that our project goals were consistently aligned with client expectations. My focus on maintaining high-quality standards fostered a culture of excellence within the team. Working in a dynamic startup environment allowed me to hone my leadership and project management skills, contributing to the overall success of our projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · C (Programming Language) · System Architecture · Communication · Software Engineering · Software Development · Embedded Systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer R&D
positions.description: At Cardinal Scale Mfg. Co., I played a pivotal role in managing software solutions for innovative and legacy products. My responsibilities included leading a software team, mentoring junior engineers, and designing embedded systems for digital scales and medical applications. I also coordinated with management and customers to ensure software requirements were met effectively.
positions.insights: Skills: Medical Devices · Microcontrollers · Project Planning · C (Programming Language) · System Architecture · Communication · Electronics · Software Engineering · Software Development · Embedded Systems

projects.title: Firefox
projects.description: The Firefox web browser for desktop. I am a module peer of the Glean SDK integration and the legacy telemetry implementation. I have contributed to many areas from the Gecko web platform to the front end UI and addons. My contributions have earned me permanent recognition in the Firefox credits.

projects.title: Glean.js
projects.description: Stand-alone JavaScript implementation of the Glean SDK for web platform use. Designed to the same specifications as Glean Core SDK but optimized to run inside a webpage.
